raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (327 rows, exactly the 327 source_tz='UTC' rows) was delivered with UTC timestamps, while every other batch uses naive America/Chicago local time. Its evening transactions (after 18:00 Chicago) land on 2026-01-18 00:00-06:00 and are assigned to the wrong business date and hour. The fix converts UTC rows to Chicago local time (CST, UTC-6 in January, no DST) before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
